title: Doom Saved Reality. Then Made It Kneel.
description: Part 1 of an original spoiler recap and commentary about Marvel Comics Secret Wars (2015), written by Jonathan Hickman and drawn by Esad Ribic. Comics canon, not a prediction of the MCU films.
hook: The Marvel multiverse fell apart. Doctor Doom kept the pieces.
payoff: Doom hid the old reality from his people. But the raft's survivors still remembered it.

units.text: The Marvel multiverse fell apart. Doctor Doom kept the pieces.
units.visual_query: Original symbolic comic diagram: THE END. THEN DOOM.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: In Secret Wars, the 2015 comic, universes were crashing into one another.
units.visual_query: Original symbolic comic diagram: SECRET WARS · 2015 COMICS

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Reed Richards built a survival raft. But escape didn't bring the survivors home.
units.visual_query: Original symbolic comic diagram: ESCAPE WAS NOT HOME

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: They woke on Battleworld: fragments of destroyed worlds stitched into one planet.
units.visual_query: Original symbolic comic diagram: BROKEN WORLDS → BATTLEWORLD

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Doom had made that planet, and every territory answered to him.
units.visual_query: Original symbolic comic diagram: ONE WORLD. ONE RULER.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Battleworld's people were expected to worship Doom as their god.
units.visual_query: Original symbolic comic diagram: BATTLEWORLD WORSHIPS DOOM

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Doom hid the old reality from his people. But the raft's survivors still remembered it.
units.visual_query: Original symbolic comic diagram: THE OUTSIDERS REMEMBER

units.speaker: Narrator
